text: Yeah now the problem also is that i technically only know merging to happen when like you said they are next to one another, but this is not the case. [Image #11] this is going to merge left leg with the right knee for example because of the order (which, is not currently instrumented to reorder)
resolution: Answered the merge-target worry (no code): merge is NEVER based on outliner list order — 'adjacent' meant adjacent in 3D by the user's choice. Verified the outliner already has shift-click multi-select (req_2659, AppFrame selectPart) with group verbs acting on the selected SET and viewport highlight of the set. The merge gesture is: click part A, shift-click part B (any rows, any positions), hit Merge — acts on exactly the selection, same contract as duplicate/delete group verbs. knee_right + lower_leg_right merge cleanly even with lower_leg_left between them in the list. No reorder instrumentation required.
